editorial:
Imagine waking up in a small town where everyone is terrified of witches and the government is ready to kill anyone who looks suspicious. That is exactly where you land in this story. You get to see how a greedy man started a blood pact with a demon to get power, which basically cursed the town for hundreds of years. It feels like a mix of a history lesson and a nightmare, but it stays fun because it connects back to the kids in 1994 who are trying to stop the killing spree. The vibe is dark and moody, but it never feels too slow because there is always something scary or shocking happening around the corner.

What really works here is how the movie handles the twists. You think you know who the bad guy is, but the reveals keep you guessing. The acting is solid, and the costumes make the old-school setting feel real. One downside is that some of the gore might be a bit much for some people, but if you love horror, you will be fine. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends who love a good mystery.
endingExplained: You find out that the curse started when Sarah Fier was framed for witchcraft. The real villain was the town leader who made a deal with a demon. In the end, the kids in 1994 have to break the cycle of blood. By killing the source of the evil and stopping the ritual, they finally free the town from the demon's grip. The curse is broken, and the ghosts are finally able to rest in peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slasher films and time-travel mysteries.
